iterations.prompt:
Create ONE isolated spear weapon sprite for a cute flat 2D mobile game with plump ginger cats. This is a stroke-style approval sample, NOT a glossy loot icon. One single spear only, upright and straight, centered with generous margin on a completely uniform pure white background. No character, no hands, no labels, no frame. 1024x1024 canvas; entire spear from y=100 to y=924, all parts fully visible. Simple side/front orthographic sprite, no perspective.
DESIGN: a broad stout silver-steel leaf spearhead with a strong pointed center and gently rounded swept shoulders; the head is about 32 percent of the full spear length and visibly wider than the wooden shaft. A short honey-brass socket, a straight warm medium-brown wooden shaft, a practical muted coral/red leather grip wrapped around the lower middle, and a small plain brass butt cap. The construction should feel crafted and playful, not a generic triangle on a stick. No gems, mascot face, runes, dangling cloth, extra blades, tiny screws or textures.
LINE GRAMMAR IS ESSENTIAL: all background-facing silhouette edges use one confident warm dark brown contour, round caps/joins, visually about 32-36 pixels at this source scale, intended to become roughly 9px when fitted at 256x240 cat canvas. Interior surface lines are authored selectively and relate to local material: cool medium gray steel seam, ochre-brown on brass, warm muted reddish-brown on the leather. They are quieter than the silhouette. Strong real overlap edges can use main structural weight; DO NOT outline every color patch or every wrap with the thick exterior ink. A shared physical edge has ONE line only. Leave broad clean color areas between lines. A wide steel side plane is a flat filled gray region, not a thick charcoal center stripe. Use at most one short steel construction mark and 3 clean curved wrap seam marks; no web of nested outlines. Do not make all interior lines one gray color. Do not use a black cage around the grip. End short seams cleanly.
RENDERING: opaque flat solid color fills with only broad separate material-color regions. No gradients, glossy highlights, bevel render, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, glow, lighting effects, 3D, realistic texture, crosshatching, grain or watercolor. Warm friendly chunky silhouette with the same visual density as a thick-outlined cartoon cat. Pure white background has no shadow.

The silver leaf spearhead is a wide squat leaf about280px wide and280px high, not a long narrow dagger. Wooden shaft is about115px wide INCLUDING its two outlines; its visible interior colored wood strip is about43px wide. The whole silhouette contour is a VERY FAT 36-PX WARM DARK BROWN MARKER LINE (#583f21), rounded joins. This dark border must read almost as broad as the orange wood fill stripe. Cartoon mascot body outline weight. Big generous colored regions must be drawn to accommodate these thick main outlines. Do not use a thin 8px/12px outline. Do not give this object the slender proportions of a real spear. On a256px cat canvas, this spear is200px high and its main contour is9px. Build these proportions into the drawing itself.

Steel head has two broad flat light-gray material fields, one pale cool gray and one slightly darker gray. Their shared center boundary has NO dark stripe. The steel/socket contact can have one strong structural edge. Socket has ONE slim muted ochre seam. Wood interior is a single uniform fill without grain.
